# Composed-document snapshots and the assertion over them.
#
# These are nv-main's files, listed here on purpose. They are goldens of the
# COMPOSED coworker set, so any overlay that adds coworker types must update them
# in the same PR or the composer tests fail — the edit is mechanically forced, not
# a choice. Same shape as nv-dashboard's `src/db/db-v2.test.ts` entry: the branch
# that adds the thing owns the assertion about it.
src/claude-composer/__goldens__/base-common.md
src/claude-composer/__goldens__/base-common.persona.md
src/claude-composer/__goldens__/default.md
src/claude-composer/__goldens__/default.persona.md
src/claude-composer/parity.test.ts

# DELIBERATELY NOT LISTED — this branch currently diverges from nv-main on four
# more shared files, and none of them is mechanically forced:
#
#   container/hooks/pr-auto-map.sh
#   container/skills/explain-diff-html/SKILL.md
#   container/skills/learnings-wiki/test_learnings_wiki.py
#   docs/USAGE.md
#
# Granting standing permission would let this overlay keep editing shared surfaces
# no one reviews on nv-main. Leaving them out costs nothing today — check.py's
# sync-branch exemption already passes any unowned file whose blob matches
# origin/nv-main exactly, so a sync PR carrying nv-main's version is fine. The
# guard only speaks up when someone edits one of them again on this branch, which
# is exactly the moment a human should decide whether it belongs on nv-main.
